ZAF.note: Document mentions rural coverage only in a licensing inquiry; no rural programme or rural/urban use figures.

facts.fact: ICASA, the regulator, received 32 submissions from operators, satellite firms and industry bodies in phase one of its I-ECNS licensing inquiry and published a Discussion Document with a thematic analysis of them and its preliminary responses, in Government Gazette 55654 on 30 October 2026, inviting written representations within 45 working days.

ZAF.note: No rural electricity access figure stated.
Satellite operators' submissions on licensing are stated, but no licence granted or service on sale.
